name: error-frame-server-capacity
description: An error frame carrying server_capacity, the code M1 makes reachable.
notes: Replaces invalid/error-code-server-capacity.json, which existed to assert this code was NOT in the v0 registry. ROJ-39 deleted that vector and added the code in the same commit, exactly as its own notes instructed. The message says nothing about which limit was hit — §8 and spec §17/§18 keep capacity numbers out of a frame anyone can provoke.
